HISTORICAL mine worker: broad low ink splat, scuffed leather miner cap with unlit little candle bracket ABOVE eyes, short wooden-handled pickaxe and small brass safety lantern at flank. Heavy uneven lids, deep crooked closed toothless frown. Personality: Considers daylight an administrative rumour.
